metaData.originalTitle: "OncoAgent: A Dual-Tier Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy-Preserving Oncology Clinical Decision Support"
metaData.title: "OncoAgent: A Dual-Tier Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy-Preserving Oncology Clinical Decision Support"
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: OncoAgent presents an open-source, privacy-preserving clinical decision support system for oncology that combines a dual-tier fine-tuned LLM architecture with a multi-agent LangGraph topology and a Corrective RAG pipeline, achieving a 56x throughput acceleration on AMD MI300X hardware.
metaData.summary: This technical paper introduces OncoAgent, a comprehensive open-source system designed to assist oncologists with clinical decision-making while preserving patient privacy. The system features a dual-tier architecture that routes simple queries to a 9B parameter model and complex cases to a 27B deep-reasoning model, both fine-tuned via QLoRA on 266,854 oncological cases. A key innovation is the integration of a four-stage Corrective RAG pipeline over 70+ NCCN and ESMO guidelines, combined with a three-layer reflexion safety validator that enforces a strict Zero-PHI policy. The entire stack runs on a single AMD Instinct MI300X instance using ROCm, eliminating cloud API dependencies. The paper reports significant performance achievements, including a 56x throughput acceleration for synthetic data generation (6,800 vs. 120 cases/hour) and full-dataset fine-tuning in approximately 50 minutes. The system architecture decomposes clinical reasoning across eight specialized LangGraph nodes, each with bounded, auditable functions, and includes a mandatory human-in-the-loop gate for high-complexity cases.

mainPoints.point: OncoAgent combines a dual-tier LLM architecture with a multi-agent LangGraph topology for oncology clinical decision support.
mainPoints.explanation: The system routes queries based on complexity to either a 9B speed-optimized model or a 27B deep-reasoning model, both fine-tuned on 266,854 oncological cases, enabling efficient handling of diverse clinical scenarios.

mainPoints.point: A four-stage Corrective RAG pipeline with explicit relevance gating eliminates hallucinated recommendations.
mainPoints.explanation: The pipeline includes recall, distance gating, cross-encoder re-ranking, and context trimming, with a hard anti-hallucination threshold that returns a safe refusal for out-of-domain queries.

mainPoints.point: The system achieves a 56x throughput acceleration for synthetic data generation on AMD MI300X hardware.
mainPoints.explanation: Using Unsloth's FastLanguageModel with sequence packing on AMD Instinct MI300X, the team generated 96,941 synthetic cases at 6,800 cases/hour versus 120 cases/hour via API, and fine-tuned the full 266k-sample corpus in approximately 50 minutes.

mainPoints.point: A three-layer reflexion safety validator enforces a strict Zero-PHI policy with deterministic safety checks.
mainPoints.explanation: The Critic node runs formatting, safety, and LLM entailment checks as deterministic code, preventing adversarial bypass, while a dedicated Zero-PHI redaction node removes all protected health information before any LLM processing.

mainPoints.point: The complete system is 100% open-source and deployable on-premises, eliminating proprietary cloud API dependency.
mainPoints.explanation: All training, inference, RAG, and UI components run on a single AMD MI300X instance using ROCm, enabling hospital deployment without data exfiltration and satisfying HIPAA/GDPR requirements.

keyQuotes: OncoAgent combines a dual-tier fine-tuned LLM architecture with a state-of-the-art multi-agent LangGraph topology, a four-stage Corrective RAG pipeline over 70+ physician-grade NCCN and ESMO guidelines, and a three-layer reflexion safety validator enforcing a strict Zero-PHI policy.
Sequence packing on MI300X enabled full-dataset fine-tuning in approximately 50 minutes --- a 56× throughput acceleration over API-based generation.
The Critic runs as deterministic code, not LLM-controlled logic --- ensuring safety enforcement cannot be bypassed by adversarial prompting.
The system demonstrates that production-grade clinical AI does not require proprietary infrastructure: the full stack runs on a single AMD Instinct MI300X instance under ROCm.

Any query failing Stage 2 returns 'Información no concluyente en las guías provistas' without invoking the Specialist. This guarantees zero hallucinated recommendations for out-of-domain clinical inputs.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Falcon Perception is a 0.6B early-fusion Transformer that unifies vision and language in a single backbone for open-vocabulary grounding and segmentation, outperforming SAM 3 on complex compositional prompts.

relatedArticles.title: Paperclip: Hire AI Agents Like Employees (Live Demo)
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Paperclip founder Dota demos an AI agent orchestration platform designed to run 'zero-human companies' — teams of AI agents with defined roles, memory, and skills that operate autonomously under human strategic direction.

relatedArticles.title: How I Created OpenClaw, the Breakthrough AI Agent
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Peter Steinberger shares his journey from burnout to building OpenClaw, a wildly popular open-source AI agent that autonomously solves problems, explores its transformative potential for non-coders, and discusses the risks and future of multi-agent collaboration.

relatedArticles.title: Memory and Dreaming for Self-Learning Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Anthropic introduces Memory and Dreaming, two new primitives for its Managed Agents API, enabling agents to achieve continuous self-learning by managing their own knowledge in a file system-like structure and asynchronously curating that knowledge to improve over time.

relatedArticles.title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents， Audio and Video Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA introduces Nemotron 3 Nano Omni, a new open-weight omni-modal model that combines text, image, video, and audio understanding with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-MoE backbone, achieving top accuracy on multiple multimodal leaderboards while delivering up to 9x higher throughput.

relatedArticles.title: How NVIDIA AI-Q Reached \#1 on DeepResearch Bench I and II
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: NVIDIA AI-Q achieves state-of-the-art performance on deep research benchmarks through a modular multi-agent architecture, fine-tuned Nemotron-3 models, and specialized reliability middleware.

relatedArticles.title: Open SWE: An Open-Source Framework for Internal Coding Agents
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Open SWE is an open-source framework by LangChain that enables organizations to build customizable internal coding agents based on production-proven patterns like isolated sandboxes and seamless workflow integration.

relatedArticles.title: Welcome Gemma 4: Frontier multimodal intelligence on device
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Google DeepMind releases Gemma 4, a family of open, multimodal models (2.3B to 31B parameters) featuring architectural innovations like Per-Layer Embeddings and Shared KV Cache for efficient on-device and long-context performance.

relatedArticles.title: What I Learned Building Multi-Agent Systems From Scratch
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A staff engineer at Shopify shares the journey of building multi-agent systems from scratch, revealing that narrow-focused agents outperform generalists, and that empowering domain experts with tools is more effective than creating an AI SWAT team.

relatedArticles.title: Building a Fast Multilingual OCR Model with Synthetic Data
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details NVIDIA's development of Nemotron OCR v2, a fast and accurate multilingual OCR model trained on a massive, open-source synthetic dataset of 12.2 million images, overcoming data scarcity through a scalable, language-agnostic rendering pipeline.
